text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Thank you so much for the break~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I spent the whole day relaxing
at my favorite bedrock bath!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my body feels so light, and my skin is all soft and bouncy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was such a nice day off~!
I'll let you know about the shop sometime, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Hishi Miracle was able to
get plenty of rest on her day off.
